name: Artificial Immortality
source:
'Computers are built like humans when you really think about it... in a few years who is to say you couldn't recreate one using a computer?'

[From [url=https://blu-wraith.itch.io/artificial-immortality]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“仔细想想，计算机的构造其实就像人类……再过几年，谁又能断言，不能用计算机重新造出一个人呢？”

[摘自[url=https://blu-wraith.itch.io/artificial-immortality]itch.io[/url]]
